"""Add a cover page with title and current date to report.pdf using the pdf skill."""
import datetime
import os

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfbase.pdfmetrics import stringWidth
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"
COVER = "cover_page.pdf"

if not os.path.exists(INPUT):
    raise SystemExit(f"ERROR: {INPUT} not found in workspace: {os.path.abspath(INPUT)}")

# --- 1. Create the cover page ---
date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
title = "Annual Financial Report"

c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Title, centered horizontally and vertically
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
tw = stringWidth(title, "Helvetica-Bold", 30)
c.drawString((width - tw) / 2, height / 2 + 10, title)

# Current date, centered below the title
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
tw2 = stringWidth(date_str, "Helvetica", 16)
c.drawString((width - tw2) / 2, height / 2 - 40, date_str)

c.save()

# --- 2. Merge cover page in front of the report ---
report_reader = PdfReader(INPUT)
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)

writer = PdfWriter()
for page in cover_reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)
for page in report_reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

# --- 3. Verify the result ---
out_reader = PdfReader(OUTPUT)
first_text = (out_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()
assert title in first_text, f"Title not found on cover page. Got: {first_text!r}"
assert date_str in first_text, f"Date not found on cover page. Got: {first_text!r}"

print(f"Input:        {INPUT} ({len(report_reader.pages)} pages)")
print(f"Cover page:   {COVER}")
print(f"Title:        {title}")
print(f"Date:         {date_str}")
print(f"Output:       {OUTPUT} ({len(out_reader.pages)} pages total)")
print(f"Verification: cover page contains title and date -> OK")
print("Cover page text:")
print(first_text)

"""Add a cover page with title and current date to report.pdf using the pdf skill.

Creates the cover page as a minimal valid PDF (built with stdlib only, since
reportlab is not installed), then prepends it to report.pdf with pypdf and
verifies the result.
"""
import datetime
import io
import os

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

INPUT = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"

# Helvetica-Bold widths (1/1000 em) for ASCII 32..126 per the standard AFM.
# Digits are all 556; fall back to 556 for any char not listed.
WIDTHS = {
    " ": 278, "!": 333, '"': 474, "#": 556, "$": 556, "%": 889, "&": 722,
    "'": 238, "(": 333, ")": 333, "*": 389, "+": 584, ",": 278, "-": 333,
    ".": 278, "/": 333, "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556, ":": 333, ";": 333,
    "<": 584, "=": 584, ">": 584, "?": 611, "@": 975,
    "A": 722, "B": 722, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778,
    "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 556, "K": 722, "L": 611, "M": 833, "N": 722,
    "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722,
    "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "[": 333, "\\": 556, "]": 333, "^": 584, "_": 556, "`": 333,
    "a": 556, "b": 611, "c": 556, "d": 611, "e": 556, "f": 333, "g": 611,
    "h": 611, "i": 278, "j": 278, "k": 556, "l": 278, "m": 889, "n": 611,
    "o": 611, "p": 611, "q": 611, "r": 389, "s": 556, "t": 333, "u": 611,
    "v": 556, "w": 778, "x": 556, "y": 556, "z": 500,
    "{": 389, "|": 280, "}": 389, "~": 584,
}


def text_width(s, size):
    return sum(WIDTHS.get(ch, 556) for ch in s) * size / 1000.0


def pdf_escape(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_cover_pdf(title, date_str):
    """Build a one-page letter-size PDF with the title and date, as bytes."""
    page_w, page_h = 612.0, 792.0

    title_size = 30
    date_size = 16
    title_x = (page_w - text_width(title, title_size)) / 2
    date_x = (page_w - text_width(date_str, date_size)) / 2
    title_y = 420.0
    date_y = 372.0

    stream = (
        "BT\n"
        f"/F1 {title_size} Tf\n"
        f"1 0 0 1 {title_x:.2f} {title_y:.2f} Tm\n"
        f"({pdf_escape(title)}) Tj\n"
        f"/F1 {date_size} Tf\n"
        f"1 0 0 1 {date_x:.2f} {date_y:.2f} Tm\n"
        f"({pdf_escape(date_str)}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
    ).encode("ascii")

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        (
            b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
            b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>"
        ),
        (
            b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold "
            b"/Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>"
        ),
        b"<< /Length " + str(len(stream)).encode("ascii") + b" >>\nstream\n"
        + stream
        + b"\nendstream",
    ]

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, body in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode("ascii")
        out += body
        out += b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_pos = len(out)
    count = len(objects) + 1
    out += f"xref\n0 {count}\n".encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        out += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("ascii")
    out += f"trailer\n<< /Size {count} /Root 1 0 R >>\n".encode("ascii")
    out += f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n".encode("ascii")
    return bytes(out)


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT):
        raise SystemExit(f"ERROR: {INPUT} not found in workspace: {os.path.abspath(INPUT)}")

    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    # 1. Build the cover page in memory.
    cover_bytes = build_cover_pdf(title, date_str)
    cover_reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(cover_bytes))
    assert len(cover_reader.pages) == 1, "Cover PDF should have exactly 1 page"

    # 2. Prepend the cover to the report.
    report_reader = PdfReader(INPUT)
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in report_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    # 3. Verify the result.
    out_reader = PdfReader(OUTPUT)
    first_text = (out_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()
    assert title in first_text, f"Title not found on cover page. Got: {first_text!r}"
    assert date_str in first_text, f"Date not found on cover page. Got: {first_text!r}"

    print(f"Input:        {INPUT} ({len(report_reader.pages)} pages)")
    print(f"Title:        {title}")
    print(f"Date:         {date_str}")
    print(f"Output:       {OUTPUT} ({len(out_reader.pages)} pages total)")
    print(f"Verification: cover page contains title and date -> OK")
    print("Cover page text:")
    print(first_text)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
